meta.title: A started technical round cannot be rescheduled
gaps: The requested PATCH to the technical round with bid_start_time and bid_end_time is not expressible: no operation supports rescheduling both fields or the corresponding request body.
The decisive reschedule attempt and confirmation that it leaves the technical round unchanged are not checked.
warnings: a plan with only read-backs is judged by its assertions; the expected outcome is treated as accept

words.preconditions: A fresh RFP + RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited to both rounds; both open for about 20 minutes.
steps: As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “status” equals active.
words.expected: The app refuses it with “You cannot re-schedule this event!”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals active.
